{{dablink|For other uses of the word "red" and "rod," see [[Red]] and [[Rod]].}}
The '''red rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The rod is as thick as a person's wrist, is bright crimson red, and is smooth and rounded. It seems to be made from stone, though it is soft to the touch, firm rather than hard.

==Use==
The exact use of the rod is unknown. It feels almost hot when held in the hand, but not with real heat. The ''ter'angreal'' made [[Elayne]] think of fire when she held it, and when she channeled fire into the rod, she lost consciousness. Upon awakening, everyone refused to tell her what happened and struggled to keep from rolling on the floor laughing.{{ref/book|8|20}}

The evidence, including the shape and flexibility of the rod, seems to indicate that this ''ter'angreal'' is some sort of sexual aid.

==Parallels==
The design of the rod and the nature of implications around it are reminiscent of the {{Wlink|sot|Agiel|Agiel}} wielded by the {{Wlink|sot|Mord-Sith}} from Terry Goodkind's ''Sword of Truth'' series. The first appearance of the Agiel predates the first appearance of the red rod ({{8}}) by several years. However, given certain quotes by Robert Jordan regarding Terry Goodkind, it is unlikely that the [[Similarities to Sword of Truth|similarities]] are intentional or significant. It is not known if Robert Jordan was familiar enough with ''The Sword of Truth'' to even be aware of the Agiel.
